title: SafeRoute synthetic and prototype data

generated_fields.method: Deterministically randomized inside the streetlight pilot bounds
generated_fields.purpose: Visualization only; not a real district boundary or incident location

generated_fields.method: Uploaded district Total cases normalized against the highest Total and scaled to a 1-85 index
generated_fields.purpose: Prototype comparison index, not a per-capita crime rate

prototype_assumptions: Police points are reference points, not verified live station locations.
Police and route ETA values are estimates.
Missing streetlight proximity is labeled unverified, not proven darkness.
